note: One text per SafetyGuidanceKey in the house contract. Shown verbatim on urgent cases; the agent never writes its own safety text (PRD §18.4). '{circuit}' is replaced with the circuit's name. Lines marked "Penjaga's own wording" have no official source and must say so wherever sources are listed.

sg_burst_pipe.text: Turn off the water supply: close the main stop valve near your water meter.
sg_burst_pipe.source: Air Selangor leak advice (identify the leak, turn off the water supply, call a plumber); the valve's location is Penjaga's own wording

sg_burst_pipe.text: Call a SPAN-registered plumber to find and repair the leak.
sg_burst_pipe.source: Air Selangor leak advice and its SPAN-registered plumber recommendation

sg_circuit_overload.text: Unplug some of the appliances on {circuit} now, starting with high-power ones.
Don't plug too many appliances into one socket, and switch sockets off when they're not in use.
sg_circuit_overload.source: Suruhanjaya Tenaga: avoid overloading sockets with too many or high-load appliances; switch off unused appliances (advisory, 24 Dec 2024)

sg_circuit_overload.text: Move a high-power appliance to a socket on a different circuit.

sg_repeated_trips.text: Don't keep resetting a breaker that trips again. Leave it off and unplug what is on that circuit.
sg_repeated_trips.source: Electrical trade practice (no primary ST page covers repeated tripping)

sg_repeated_trips.text: Contact an ST-registered electrical contractor, and check their CPIC card.
sg_repeated_trips.source: Suruhanjaya Tenaga: registered electrical contractors and the Competent Person Identification Card

sg_repeated_trips.text: Don't open the distribution board yourself.
Once it's fixed, test your safety switch (RCD) once a month by pressing its 'T' button.
sg_repeated_trips.source: Suruhanjaya Tenaga: test the RCD with its 'T' button at least once a month (advisory, 24 Dec 2024)
